reason: The hypothesis directly restates the core idea, intervention, mechanism, and predicted outcome from P2 and P7, which already demonstrated the exact same microstructural engineering approach (inverted BCC + B2) on a refractory high-entropy alloy to improve room-temperature ductility while retaining high strength. The application to NbMoTaW is a minor change of alloy composition without new justification, and the addition of irradiation resistance is a generic claim unsupported by the cited passages.
copied_elements: dual-phase BCC + B2 microstructure with discrete B2 precipitates in continuous BCC matrix
phase inversion from ordered B2 matrix to disordered BCC matrix
controlled annealing treatment to achieve the microstructure
improved room-temperature ductility while maintaining high yield strength
activation of nano-twinning and transformation-induced plasticity mechanisms
